name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, vendor HTTP equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery is not execution support. The exact legacy read tuple is connected-read-admitted and future mismatches fail closed; legacy general writers remain runtime-disabled. Three declaration snapshots cover 835 distinct methods. EasyEDA 3.2.209 has thirteen tools for API reference, local discovery, status, bounded calculations/system/language/viewport and editor/shortcut observations, public catalog search/metadata, ordinary launch and a disposable project/PCB opening lifecycle with layer metadata, copper count and nine primitive-family projections. Catalog queries require explicit network confirmation, support footprint/symbol/device search and known metadata lookup, and run without EasyEDA or SDK execution. Layer and primitive reads retain the original receiver and compare two ordered samples. Primitive projections cover Line, Arc, Via, parentless String, Component, Pad, grouped Attribute, Dimension and Image. They do not prove complete model membership, reciprocal ownership, physical stackup, connectivity or saved contents. Opening can migrate, replay caches and automatically Save; original normal cleanup remains required. No general geometry, writer, explicit Save, worker/model or recovery route is registered on209. Source/offline checks and installed snapshots are separate from connected validation. Older profiles retain their exact eligible metadata workflows and disposable validation routes; those proofs do not transfer to209. General writers and ratline capture integration remain unfinished. No unrestricted JavaScript, arbitrary command, Save/Discard choice, force exit or blind retry is exposed. Historical journals cannot recreate ownership. Consult the skills and coverage inventory for exact scope.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
